name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. It delivers 128K context, strong reasoning, and near-frontier performance at half the cost of Opus 4.8—freeing budget for more runs. The trade-off is slightly lower raw capability than the absolute top models, but the cost savings and proven stability outweigh the marginal gap.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K claim is unverified—our tests show context loss past 32K, making it a gamble for long inputs. A safer bet is Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (if accessible) or Mixtral-8x22B-Instruct—both have verified 128K context and lower cost than Opus 4.8. Run a controlled test: feed a 100K-token prompt and measure recall accuracy—if it drops below 90%, discard it.
